Sundial Labs closes seed round

Sundial Labs has closed a seed round of undisclosed size, led by Nordic Seed Partners.

Sundial Labs is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, and builds scheduling software for clinics.

The Nordic software market has grown steadily as companies across the region adopt cloud tools, and investors have kept writing early cheques for teams with paying customers.
